Keep files only for real user inputs under evals/files/, and if you want to track which reference each case exercises, add an assertion such as 'Follows the Docusaurus ::: syntax from references/blog-posts.md'

findings.evidence: Step 6: '404 means a wrong template ID; 422 means an unknown style or font, or a width or height of 1-9; 415 means a background or style image URL the service cannot fetch'. These are status-code facts that can change between versions of the vendor's API, and SKILL.md gives no source or check date for them. Only references/image-memes.md carries 'checked live against api.memegen.link and the service README ... on 2026-11-07'
